npcs.name: Wenna Trevose
npcs.idle: The sea took Lyonesse in a night. It didn't take everyone. It didn't let anyone go, either.

npcs.name: Sir Kendric
npcs.idle: I watch for the Arawnites. One of us has to.

npcs.name: Remnant-Captain Meliot
npcs.idle: We're what's left of Lyonesse that can still hold a sword. It isn't much. It's enough.

npcs.name: Harper Gwennol
npcs.idle: Tristan was the best harper who ever lived. We keep his songs. Somebody must.

quests.title: The Last Evening of Lyonesse
quests.offer:
The drowned of Lyonesse - the danaoin - live their last day over and over. Sowing, fishing, mending nets. Waiting for an evening that never comes.

My sister Morvah wandered off a month ago. Yesterday I saw her from the hill - working the nets with the drowned on the north-west strand. Doing what they do. She didn't know me. Will you [bring her back]?
quests.summary: Wenna Trevose's sister has begun living the drowned folk's endless last day.

steps.goal: Cross the drowned meadows west of the camp
steps.text: Pale spirits drift over the meadow - peallaidh, the drowned land's restless dead. They hum as they go, the same four notes over and over.

steps.goal: Lay the meadow's restless dead to rest
steps.text: As each one fades it sighs, very softly: 'Is it evening yet?' The humming goes on, far off to the north-west, toward the strand.

steps.goal: Search the path down to the north-west strand
steps.text: Morvah's shawl, folded and left on a stone - the way the drowned leave their things before the tide comes. Below, on the strand, a woman sits mending nets among the drowned sailors.

steps.say:
Mind the nets, please. They must be mended by evening.

Wenna? I... I had a sister called Wenna. If I stop, you see, the day ends. And when the day ends, the water comes. They don't want the water to come again. I don't want it to come for them. Do you understand? It's nearly [evening].

steps.goal: Stand with Morvah as the day breaks
steps.text: The drowned sailors stand still in the surf. The sky goes red, then gold, then dark. For the first time in a thousand years, it is evening in Lyonesse.

stages.name: Keep Morvah alive
stages.announce: You take the needle from Morvah's hand. Every danaoin on the strand turns its head.

stages.name: the Drowned Reeve
stages.announce: A drowned man in a reeve's chain stalks up out of the waves. 'THE DAY IS NOT DONE. THE NETS ARE NOT MENDED.'

steps.say:
It's evening. They're going to sleep - all of them, all along the strand. They aren't afraid any more.

Wenna. I remember Wenna now. But someone has to stay and mend the nets, or tomorrow it starts again. I could [stay], and they'd sleep every night from now on. Or I could [come home], and they'd wake tomorrow and never know.

options.say: Then take me home. Before I change my mind. Before the morning.
Tell Wenna I remembered her. Tell her I'm the ferrywoman of Lyonesse now. Tell her to come to the strand at evening, sometimes.

steps.say:
She's here. She's asleep in my tent, holding my hand like when we were small.

She said the drowned will wake tomorrow and never know they had an evening. I said that's not our trouble. I hope I'm right.

She stayed. She remembered me, and she stayed.

I went up the hill at dusk and looked. The strand was quiet. And there was one lantern, down at the water, mending nets. I'll go every evening.

home.text: Take something. You've given me back my sister.

stayed.text: She'd want you to have this.

quests.title: The Sacrament of Arawn
quests.offer:
This is work for a GROUP - gather friends before you go.

The priests of Arawn are gathering at the ruined cathedral in the south. My squire Tobin went to scout and didn't come back. Under the cathedral, the old knights of Lyonesse lie drowned with their king. The Arawnites mean to wake them - as theirs.

Will you [go after Tobin]? Their grove on the eastern cliffs will tell you what they intend.
quests.summary: GROUP. The priests of Arawn mean to raise Lyonesse's drowned knights at the ruined cathedral, and Sir Kendric's squire went to scout them.

steps.goal: Find the Arawnites' grove on the eastern cliffs
steps.text: Arawnite shamanesses dance around a fire of bones. A sealed scroll hangs from a stake in the middle.

steps.goal: Take the orders from the grove
steps.text: 'At the ruined cathedral, on the dark of the moon. The squire will do. His blood will wake the knights, and they will kneel to Arawn.'

steps.goal: Cut down the drowned footmen guarding the southern road
steps.text: They wear the drowned king's colours, but their eyes are already Arawn's.
Priests in black kneel among the broken pillars. Tobin is tied to the altar-stone, white-faced and very angry.
The hierophant collapses across the altar. Under the floor, something that was stirring goes still again.

stages.name: Hierophant Morcant of Arawn
stages.announce: A priest in a mask of bone rises from the altar. 'You are too late, and also just in time - Arawn accepts all blood.'

steps.say:
About time! - sorry. Sorry. Thank you.

There's a reliquary under the altar, sir - I mean, friend. Black glass. It's what wakes them. Sir Kendric needs to [see it].

steps.goal: Bring Tobin and the reliquary to Sir Kendric
steps.say:
Tobin! Thank every god there is.

And that - that's the reliquary? With it, a knight of Albion could wake the drowned knights of Lyonesse. As OURS. Two hundred knights for the realm's wars.

Or we [shatter it], and they sleep forever. I know which I should choose. I don't trust myself. You decide: [wake them for Albion], or shatter it.

options.say: Yes. Yes. Let the dead keep their own. ... There. Did you feel that? Like a held breath going out.
Then I'll keep it, and I'll keep it well, and gods help me if I'm wrong. Tobin, don't look at me like that.

shattered.text: From the camp. You've earned more than we have.

quests.title: The North Shore
quests.offer:
The peallaidh - the shaggy sea-things - come further up the north shore with every tide. The sea's coming with them.

Will you [push them back]?
quests.summary: Peallaidh come further up Lyonesse's north shore with every tide.

steps.goal: Push back the peallaidh about 510 m north of Remnant-Captain Meliot

steps.say: Back - for a tide or two. The sea isn't rising by itself, you know. Nothing here does anything by itself.

quests.title: Bone Snappers
quests.offer:
Bone snappers in the drowned fields to the west - big as boats, and they eat anything that floats or walks. My scouts won't cross.

Will you [clear the fields]?
quests.summary: Bone snappers hunt the drowned fields of western Lyonesse.

steps.goal: Kill the bone snappers about 730 m west of Remnant-Captain Meliot

steps.say: My scouts will cross now. Some of them, anyway.

quests.title: The Moorlich Mire
quests.offer:
Moorlich in the mire - drowned things that rose and stayed risen. The priests of Arawn call them up, I think, to keep the mire between us and their cathedral.

Will you [cross the mire]?
quests.summary: Moorlich hold the mire between the Remnant's camp and the ruined cathedral.

steps.goal: Put down the moorlich about 600 m north-west of Sir Kendric

steps.say: Crossable. Barely. The cathedral's on the far side - you know what waits there.

quests.title: Tristan's Harp
quests.offer:
The pygmy goblins of the south have a hoard, and in it - they boast of it - a harp of black yew. If it's Tristan's, it belongs to the Harpers, and to Lyonesse.

Will you [find the harp]?
quests.summary: The pygmy goblins of southern Lyonesse boast of a black yew harp in their hoard.

steps.goal: Fight through the pygmy goblin tanglers about 290 m west of Harper Gwennol

clue.name: a heap of shiny drowned things

steps.text: Under a heap of tarnished cups: a harp of black yew, the strings long gone. Carved on the pillar: a boar, and 'T'.

steps.goal: Bring the harp to Harper Gwennol
steps.say:
It's his. It's Tristan's. I can hardly hold it.

I can [restring it], here in the camp, and play his songs for the Remnant - or you can [carry it] to Tintagel, where King Mark's people would weep to see it.

options.say: Then the Remnant will hear Tristan's harp tonight. You'll stay and listen?
Then carry it gently. Mark wronged him, but Mark's people loved him.

quests.title: The Black Sail
quests.offer:
You know the end of Tristan's lay? Dying, he sent for Isolde. White sails if she was coming, black if not. She came - and his wife told him the sails were black, and he died.

The ship is in the old harbour in the north-west, the sailors say. Drowned with the rest. Will you [find the ship]?
quests.summary: Isolde's ship, the one with the sail that was white, lies drowned in Lyonesse's old harbour.

steps.goal: Get past the drowned sailors in the old harbour about 1.3 km north-west of Harper Gwennol
Search the wreck in the harbour

clue.name: a wreck with a rotted sail

steps.text: The sail, what's left of it, is white. Someone painted it black, long ago - the black flakes off under your hand. And there's a pearl caught in the rigging.

steps.say:
White. It was always white. She came for him.

I'll put that in the lay. It should have been in it all along.

quests.title: The Weeping Wood
quests.offer:
The hamadryads of the east wood used to sing with the Harpers. Now salt-water creeps into their roots and they've gone mad with it.

Will you [quiet the wood]? It's a mercy.
quests.summary: Salt-water rot drives the hamadryads of eastern Lyonesse mad.

steps.goal: Quiet the hamadryads about 320 m north-east of Harper Gwennol

steps.say: Quiet. I'll sing for them tonight.

quests.title: The Gabriel Hounds
quests.offer:
The Gabriel hounds - hounds of the sky, the old songs call them, Annwn's hounds - hunt on the hill in the west. They never came to Lyonesse before. Someone sent them.

Will you [hunt the hounds]? Bring friends.
quests.summary: The Gabriel hounds, Annwn's hounds of the sky, hunt on a hill in western Lyonesse.

steps.goal: Hunt the Gabriel hounds about 890 m north-west of Harper Gwennol

steps.say: Annwn's hounds, this far south. The priests of Arawn opened a way for them, I'd wager, at someone's asking.

quests.title: The Witherwoode
quests.offer:
In the middle mire the witherwoode stand - dead trees, walking. They grow where the cailleach breathes. They're spreading toward the camp.

Will you [fell the witherwoode]?
quests.summary: The witherwoode, dead walking trees, spread from the cailleach's mire toward the Remnant's camp.

steps.goal: Fell the witherwoode about 750 m north-west of Harper Gwennol

steps.say: They grow where she breathes. One day someone will have to stop her breathing.

quests.title: The Day the Sea Came
quests.offer:
The drowned folk in the east farms live their last day over and over - you've seen Morvah. But they remember how it ended. If you can get one to stand still long enough...

Will you [ask the drowned]? Gently, if you can.
quests.summary: The drowned farmers of eastern Lyonesse relive their last day. Wenna Trevose wants to know how it ended.

steps.goal: Calm the drowned shepherds about 400 m north-west of Wenna Trevose

clue.name: a farmhouse with the table still laid

steps.text: A journal, the last page: 'A white storm out of the south, out of a clear sky. No ordinary sea. My husband says there was a beast in the clouds, white as bone.'

steps.say:
A beast in the clouds, white as bone. The storm that drowned Lyonesse wasn't weather.

And it's coming back.

quests.title: The Storm-Callers
quests.offer:
Robed figures on the rock in the north - storm-callers, the farmers call them - sing up the white storm a little every night. The sea rises a finger's width each time.

Will you [break the singing]?
quests.summary: Storm-callers on the north rock sing up a white storm a little every night.

steps.goal: Kill the storm-callers on the rock about 670 m north of Remnant-Captain Meliot

steps.text: Claw-marks, deep, in a ring round the rock - a dragon's. And a cairn of pale stones: Dartmoor granite.

steps.say: Dartmoor granite and a dragon's claw. Golestandt drowned Lyonesse. And he means to do it again, to Cornwall.

quests.title: The Unnatural Storm
quests.offer:
The storm-callers were only the voices. The storm itself has a heart - a thing on the rock that the white dragon left behind. Kill it, and the sea stops rising.

Will you [still the storm]? Bring everyone.
quests.summary: The white dragon's storm has a heart on the north rock of Lyonesse.

steps.goal: Destroy the Unnatural Storm Controller about 680 m north of Remnant-Captain Meliot
steps.text: The storm-thing shatters. For the first time in a year, the wind drops, and the sea lies flat.

steps.say:
The sea's lying flat. I'd forgotten it could.

Cornwall's coast is safe - from this, at least. The dragon will try something else.

quests.title: The Pike Line
quests.offer:
Drowned pikemen hold a line in the south, as they did the day the sea came - still waiting for an enemy who never arrived.

Will you [break the line]?
quests.summary: Drowned pikemen hold a line in southern Lyonesse, waiting for an enemy.

steps.goal: Break the drowned pikemen about 560 m west of Sir Kendric

steps.say: Broken. They'll stand again, I expect. The knights behind them won't let them rest.

quests.title: The Drowned Knights
quests.offer:
The knights of Lyonesse stand guard in the south, round the old castle-mound - the king's guard, drowned with their king. They answer to no one now.

Will you [face the guard]? Bring everyone.
quests.summary: The drowned knights of Lyonesse's king guard the old castle-mound in the south.

steps.goal: Fight through the drowned footmen about 180 m south-west of Sir Kendric

steps.say: The king's guard is broken. Then the king himself will come out. He always does, the drowned say, when his guard falls.

quests.title: The Drowned King
quests.offer:
King Meliodas of Lyonesse - Tristan's father - drowned with his kingdom. With his guard broken he'll walk out of the castle-mound. He may be the only one who remembers what drowned us.

Will you [face the king]? Make him listen.
quests.summary: King Meliodas of Lyonesse, Tristan's drowned father, walks out of the castle-mound.

steps.goal: Go to the old castle-mound about 180 m south-west of Sir Kendric
steps.text: Water runs uphill toward the mound. A tall figure in a sea-green crown steps out of it.

Meliodas kneels in the water. 'A white beast in the clouds,' he says. 'It asked for my harbour and I said no. And now a queen in a black crown buys my priests. Tell my son's friends: the dragon is in Dartmoor, and the queen is at the lake.'

stages.name: King Meliodas of Lyonesse
stages.announce: King Meliodas, crowned in sea-wrack: 'Who walks in my kingdom? Kneel, or drown.'

steps.say:
Dartmoor and the lake. The dragon and the queen. Both threads end the same way: at the heart of each of them.

Shall we [bury the king] - here, in the mound, with honour? Or [tell the Harpers] all he said, so it goes into the lay?

options.say: Then he rests. Lyonesse's last king, under Lyonesse's last hill.
Then Gwennol will sing it, and every harper in Albion will learn it.

quests.title: The Cailleach
quests.offer:
In the middle of the mire the cailleach keeps her ring - the old hag of the sea-wind, who was here before Lyonesse and will be here after. She blew the sea in for the white dragon once. She'll do it again for anyone who pays her.

Will you [face the cailleach]? This is the hardest thing in Lyonesse. Bring everyone.
quests.summary: The cailleach, the old hag of the sea-wind, keeps her ring in the heart of the mire.

steps.goal: Fight through the cailleach's guards about 650 m north-west of Harper Gwennol

steps.text: The cailleach falls, laughing like a gale. 'The wind will find another mouth,' she says. 'It always does.' Then she's only stones.

steps.say:
She's stones. The wind is just wind tonight.

I'll write you into the lay - beside Tristan, if you'll allow it. Lyonesse will remember who stood up for it.
